_doc: The audio front end of EmbeddingGemma 2 as the TypeScript host is held to it (generated by tools/export-recipes/embeddinggemma2/audio_front_end.py).

`featureExtractor`: the settings of the pinned preprocessor_config.json that change a frame, as the file states them. `maxSamples`: the extractor's max_length call default (not a setting of the file).

`frameDigests`: per waveform of multimodal-reference.safetensors, the SHA-256 of the [4n, 128] little-endian f32 tower input (the L valid frames, then zero frames to 4n) by upstream's arithmetic with the FFT in f64: the f32 product of the samples and the f32 window (upstream's own), numpy's rfft in f64, the magnitude, the f64 mel product, log(mel + mel_floor), cast to f32. With the FFT in f32 the same steps reproduce the extractor's frames bit for bit (checked when written).
